notes.title: CometStriker DX Release!
notes.content:
[h2][b]CometStriker DX has now released as a free update![/b][/h2]

The game now includes [b]two player local coop[/b] and a [b]new challenge mode[/b] with over fifty unique bite-sized challenge levels!

Check it out!

------------------------
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
-Added challenge mode.
-Added two player local coop.
-Adjusted Lt. Striker's character graphics.
-Added "Classic Lt. Striker" option in extras menu for those who want the old character graphics.
-Adjusted Lt. Striker's shot damage/rate/fire.
-Refined analog movement.
-Reduced various explosions hitbox sizes to better match graphic.
-Disabled screen shake on a certain character's bullet explosion.
-Adjusted Scorpiod, Knight Beetle, and Super Squire Beetle on very hard difficulty.
-Adjusted hitbox on Fungi.
-Adjusted Launcher Crab boss on very hard difficulty.
-Adjusted Reanimator boss on hard and very hard difficulty.
-Bomber parasite explodes on player contact now no matter what.
-Added tell for Strider dash speed.
-Fixed Labyrinth mode not being consistent across multiple platforms.
-Gravity Antlion now has an intro animation.
-Added "Restore Defaults" button to options menu that will restore default settings.

------------------------
[h3]Note:[/h3]
[i]64-bit is required for CometStriker DX. Players with 32-bit computers will not receive this update.[/i]

notes.title: New Mode Added: Labyrinth Mode!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're back with a big update to CometStriker: Labyrinth Mode!

In the Labyrinth you will encounter over 180 new hand-crafted rooms, alongside rooms from Arcade, assembled into 5 levels to play through.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30500011/665ccfbb8065c22bdcd1e4b8c09b0e93eb716ef1.png[/img]

Some old rooms are changed...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30500011/c00af0305119919fe51eadcd625d45684bdbcc17.png[/img]

and most rooms can appear flipped!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30500011/084a30d4f729e68c5d38a6f812319c0892e697dd.png[/img]

You can see your seed at any time on the pause menu in Labyrinth Mode...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30500011/d442954431b1633d3cfbdd1460333c55e2c018ea.png[/img]

and you can enter a seed if you want to play on the same layout as someone else!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30500011/13bc83ab5db0145b6f5e3128d22063e9388d6d05.png[/img]

----------

Q : What is Labyrinth Mode?
A : Labyrinth Mode is a procedurally generated campaign, with various layout remixes and twice the possible rooms to give you a fresh playthrough every time!

Q : Are the enemy picks and placement randomly generated?
A: No. We set about building the new rooms the same way we did for the main game. You get a randomized selection of them, but the rooms themselves are purposefully designed to be fun and challenging.

Q : How do I access Labyrinth Mode?
A : Labyrinth mode is accessible in the Game Start menu. It is unlocked once you beat the first planet on any difficulty, in Arcade Mode.

Q : Are there leaderboards for Labyrinth Mode?
A : Yes, same as with all the other modes. It's at the end of the list, just before it cycles back to arcade. It does not differentiate between seeds, though, all seeds record to the same Labyrinth Mode Leaderboard. So keep that in mind.

Q : Can Labyrinth Mode be used to unlock characters / modes?
A : No, you still have to do those things in Arcade Mode. However, Labyrinth Mode does come with its own set of new achievements!

Q : Can a friend and I play the same randomly generated campaign?
A : Yes! We have an optional Seed Entry screen. If you and a friend use the same seeds, you'll get the same playthrough layout.

----------

Labyrinth Mode was a lot of work, but we think it makes a great addition to CometStriker. We hope you all enjoy it!

notes.title: In-Game Global Leaderboards Added!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30500011/fb687629caed516a57412fe184d171d2f03721cb.png[/img]

Hey everyone! We're announcing the new In-game Leaderboard, which you can check out in the game's Main Menu.

You can sort by the various categories, difficulties, and character to see how you stack up against the rest of the world!

Race against your friends and go for high scores!

Have fun!
